statement: Where a repository's squash setting is COMMIT_MESSAGES (BargLabs/cejel), a squash merge writes every commit message of the PR into the default branch, so text removed from the PR body survives in the squashed commit. Before #432 was squashed, the operator ruled that a third-party repository's verdict label must not be published. Both PR bodies were cleaned, but commit 10e9400's message still quoted that label. Reading the repository's squash_merge_commit_message setting caught it, and the message was reworded during the rebase (now bcac9a6) before #432 squashed into f6766d1. Rule: before a squash merge, read the repository's squash message setting; if it carries commit messages, review and clean every commit message, not only the PR title and body.
